name: res_asymmetry
desc: log ratio of 5' to 3' edge-position spread

name: gap_concentration
desc: how concentrated those gaps are at one position

name: polyA_score
desc: A fraction just past the 3' edge

name: flank_id
desc: pairwise identity between flanks, ungapped

name: tsd_len_med
desc: median TSD length

name: frac_supported
desc: fraction of copies with >55 % identity to the known consensus

name: g_uniqueness
desc: evidence group: are the copies in unique locations

name: n_core_frac
desc: copies that both support the consensus and sit in unique sequence

name: rank1_excess
desc: rank1_frac minus a shuffled null

name: seg_diag
desc: fraction of slots matching their own consensus segment, unaligned

name: long_gap_frac
desc: fraction of copies with an internal gap of 20 bp or more

name: g_homogeneity
desc: evidence group: is it one uniform element

name: tsd_frac
desc: fraction of copies with a target-site duplication

name: rank1_frac
desc: variance in the first SVD component of copy x window identity

name: cliff
desc: median copy-to-consensus identity minus flank background (unrelated DNA = 0.25)

name: cons_identity_med
desc: median identity of a copy to the known consensus

name: elem_len_cv
desc: spread of per-copy element length

name: score
desc: weighted geometric combination of the four evidence groups

name: sub_gap
desc: within-group minus between-group identity of the two copy clusters

name: g_element
desc: evidence group: is there an element
